title: Set admin login password to SC05GOJRI

requirements.text: Update the hardcoded admin password in the useAdminAuth hook to 'SC05GOJRI' so that entering this password on the admin login modal grants admin access.

quotes: SC05GOJRI yeh password set kar login ke liye

acceptanceCriteria: Entering 'SC05GOJRI' in the admin login modal successfully authenticates and grants admin access.
Entering any other password shows an error and denies access.
No other functionality or UI is changed.

constraints: Only change the admin password value in useAdminAuth.ts. Do not modify any other logic, UI, or backend code.
nonGoals: Adding any new features or pages.
Changing the login UI or flow.
Creating a dynamic password change mechanism.
